_source.note: Generated by the ToIP reference implementation and published in the released specification, at version YTSP-BAA (1.0). Extracted from the specification, then checked value by value against tsp_sdk 0.16.0's own tsp_sdk/test_vectors/rev3.json, which is the file the appendix was rendered from. Values are qb64 (CESR text domain), which is a direct base64url transcode of the qb2 binary domain this crate works in. The private keys are published in the spec and must never be used for anything but checking these vectors.
